narrative:
Medina County has 132,351 registered voters, with 53.8% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 29.2% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 17.1%, a pronounced Republican lean of 12.1 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.3% of registrants.
